g.text: 6T SRAM — closed-loop DC read stability testbench
Series feedback voltage sources, independent cell supply and switched storage-node force/sense
Feedback source polarities are ΔV_G = V(G) − V(QB) and ΔV_GB = V(GB) − V(Q). Disconnect both open-loop gate sweep sources.
N-curve • Keep VDD fixed and set both series sources to 0 V. Close only the switch at the initially low node.
Sweep that node from VSS to VDD and read the signed current toward the node.
VDD scan • Open both switches and set both series sources to 0 V. Lower only the local cell supply.
Keep WL, BL and BLB fixed at the initial read levels. Monitor current into the cell on the initially low side.
Noise injection • Open both switches and keep VDD fixed. For Q initially low, set ΔV_G = −Vn and ΔV_GB = +Vn.
Reverse both signs for QB initially low. Track Q and QB to detect loss of the initial state.
All voltages reference local VSS. Body ties shown for bulk CMOS. Use the model-defined terminals and bias.
